import hashlib
import os

    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

        s = p.lstat()
        rel = str(p.relative_to(root))
        if p.is_symlink():
            result[rel] = (s.st_mode, os.readlink(p))
        elif p.is_file():
            result[rel] = (s.st_mode, digest(p.read_bytes()))
        else:
            result[rel] = (s.st_mode, None)
    return result
before = snapshot()

try:

    probe.mkdir()
    (probe / 'sitecustomize.py').write_text('''import atexit

    print("PROCESS_EVIDENCE python=" + sys.version.replace("\\n", " "), flush=True)
    print("PROCESS_EVIDENCE executable=" + sys.executable, flush=True)
    for label, loaded in [("allocation", module), ("test_allocation", tests)]:

            continue
        path = Path(loaded.__file__).resolve()
        print("PROCESS_EVIDENCE " + label + "=" + str(path), flush=True)
        print("PROCESS_EVIDENCE " + label + "_sha256=" + hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), flush=True)
    if module is not None:
        print("PROCESS_EVIDENCE reserve_code=" + module.reserve.__code__.co_filename, flush=True)
atexit.register(report)
''')
    print('CURRENT_TEST_SHA256=' + digest(test_bytes), flush=True)

        case = scratch / label

        allocation = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', revision + ':allocation.py'])
        (case / 'allocation.py').write_bytes(allocation)

        env = os.environ.copy()

finally:
